gui.nullspace.card.tip.title: Card %1$s: %2$s
gui.nullspace.card.tip.unused: Not used yet. It binds to the first player who uses it.
gui.nullspace.card.tip.holder: Whoever holds it can use it.

gui.nullspace.card.revoke.tip.idle: Stops this card for good, in every hand. Anyone who came in on it is sent out.

gui.nullspace.card.bind.tip.holder: Whoever holds the card can use it, and can hand it on.

gui.nullspace.card.block.blank: You need a blank Tempad Location Card in your inventory.
gui.nullspace.card.block.limit: You have %1$s of %2$s cards in use. Revoke one first.
gui.nullspace.card.hours.tip: How long a timed card works, from the moment you print it.
